title: feat(types,plugin-dashboard): dashboard header and globalFilters state the spec member on both faces (objectui#7759 group A)
body:
Part of #7759
Clause-②: yes

This PR covers group A of objectui#7759 only: the `header` / `globalFilters` row of the `complex.zod.ts#DashboardComponentSchema` pair. The card stays open for group C (`FormSchema.layout`), which this PR does not touch.

Dev session: `https://claude.ai/code/session_014fWVhLzhxR8qrFsJ5o8TYW` (PM seat `domain:spec#1`, claim comment 5851963524).

## Determination per key (ruling 5617465269)

`@objectstack/spec` declares both keys, so principle 1 governs both: the zod mirror and the TypeScript declaration both follow the spec, in both directions.

The stop condition did not fire on either key. It covers the case where principle 1 and the objectui#4580 route point opposite ways. Here the spec types every nested label involved as `I18nLabel` (a string or an inline per-locale map), which is exactly the objectui#4580 form. So the two routes agree on the label, and principle 1 alone decides the remaining members.

| key | does the spec declare it? | before | after |
|---|---|---|---|
| `header` | **yes**. `DashboardSchema` has `header: DashboardHeaderSchema.optional()`. In `DashboardHeaderActionSchema`, `label` is `I18nLabelSchema`, `actionUrl` is `z.string()` (required), and `actionType` is `WidgetActionTypeSchema.optional()`, the spec's `ActionType` | mirror: the spec's member, by reference. Declaration: a hand-written restatement whose actions were typed `label: string`, `actionUrl?: string`, `actionType?: string` | the declaration drops the extra `'header'` omission and inherits the spec's member through the Omit projection its other spec-owned keys use |
| `globalFilters` | **yes**. `DashboardSchema` has `globalFilters: z.array(GlobalFilterSchema).optional()`. In `GlobalFilterSchema`, each `options` item is a strict `{ value, label: I18nLabelSchema }` pair. In `GlobalFilterOptionsFromSchema`, `labelField` is `z.string()` (required) and `filter` is `FilterConditionSchema.optional()` | declaration: `SpecGlobalFilter[]`, already by reference (objectui#4032). Mirror: the spec's shape spread into a local `z.object`, with `options` and `optionsFrom` restated | the mirror's `GlobalFilterSchema` is `stripImportedDefaults(SpecGlobalFilterSchema)`, the spec's schema whole. The TypeScript face is unchanged |

The pair is also in the ledger's `SPEC_DERIVED_PAIRS`.

**grep evidence.** Measured on the installed pin, `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, against its `src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`:

```
grep -nE 'header: DashboardHeaderSchema|globalFilters: z.array\(GlobalFilterSchema\)|label: I18nLabelSchema|actionUrl: z.string|labelField: z.string|filter: FilterConditionSchema' src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts
```

- **Pin (17.4.0):** the command hits all six members.
- **objectstack `main` (`8d1f7ab`):** the same file, read with `git show`, declares the same shape for both schemas. The only difference is an added `.meta({ title })` on several members, which does not change the input type.

## Measured on BASE `5c61e5241`, before any edit: both keys were DISJOINT

I measured with a throwaway probe (deleted afterwards). It checked the type face with `@ts-expect-error` legs and ran `safeParse` on the mirror:

| spelling | mirror (safeParse) | declaration (tsc) |
|---|---|---|
| header action `label: { en: … }` | accepted | refused |
| header action with no `actionUrl` | refused | accepted |
| header action `actionType: 'bogus'` | refused | accepted |
| filter `options: ['EMEA']` (bare-string shorthand) | accepted | refused |
| filter option with no `label` | accepted | refused |
| `optionsFrom` with no `labelField` | accepted | refused |
| `optionsFrom.filter` as an array | accepted | accepted (the declared `FilterCondition` type has an index signature, so it admits an array; the spec's runtime schema refuses one) |
| unknown key inside a filter | accepted, and stripped without a message | n/a |
| filter option `label: { en: … }` | **refused** | accepted |

## Premise check (the dispatch's H1–H5)

- **H1: partly false.** The ledger docblock said both keys "carry the inline-locale widening one level down". That holds for `header` only. `globalFilters` measured WIDER for a different reason: the objectui-local option shorthand and the relaxed `optionsFrom`. Its locale arm ran the other way: the mirror refused the map, which puts it on the `KnownDrift` side. The card body's group-A table inherits the same wording. The row was correct to exist; only its description was wrong.
- **H2: held.** `globalFilters` is declared as `SpecGlobalFilter[]`. `header` was omitted from the spec projection and re-declared locally, and the spec does declare it (see the table above).
- **H3: held.** The `DashboardComponentSchema` mirror line is `globalFilters: z.array(GlobalFilterSchema)`. The `z.array(z.any())` line belongs to `DashboardConfigSchema`, a different pair, which this PR leaves alone.
- **H4: held.** The pin and objectstack `main` agree on both shapes.
- **H5: held.** Both rows were retired because the pair now measures clean in both directions. `KnownDrift` keeps `widgets` for this pair, because it still measures as drift.

## What changed

- **`packages/types/src/complex.ts`**: `DashboardComponentSchema` extends the Omit projection over `DASHBOARD_SPEC_EXCLUDED` alone. The hand-written `header` is deleted, and the docblock records what it was and why it went.
- **`packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts`**: `GlobalFilterSchema = stripImportedDefaults(SpecGlobalFilterSchema)`. The local `options` / `optionsFrom` restatement and its delegated `superRefine` are gone. The spec's own object-level refinement (the date `defaultValue` check) arrives with the schema. The `SpecDashboardFields` docblock no longer calls the filter config "deliberately looser than spec's".
- **`packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`**: principle 1 requires the read site to implement every arm the spec declares. `tActionLabel` now collapses the `I18nLabel` to the active language with `pickLocalized` before using it, either as button text or as the `dashboardActionLabel` fallback. The `ActionDef` built for each header action carries the resolved label too; that memo depends on `language` rather than on a memoised resolver's identity (AGENTS.md #10). The `handleClick` fallback `actionUrl || label` was unreachable, because the guard above it already returns when `actionUrl` is empty; it is now `executeAction(actionUrl)`.
  - **Red-first on BASE source:** both new renderer cases threw `Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {en, zh-CN})`. The mirror accepted that exact document.
- **`packages/types/src/__tests__/zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`**:
  - `WiderThanDeclared` loses the pair's entry whole, and a departure note replaces it. `WIDER_ARMS` loses the pair's two rows.
  - `KnownDrift` for the pair goes from `'header' | 'widgets' | 'globalFilters'` to `'widgets'`.
  - The header figures move from 7 / 9 / 9 (split 5 / 4 / 0 / 0) to 6 / 7 / 7 (5 / 2 / 0 / 0) for `WiderThanDeclared`, and from 46 / 86 to 46 / 84 for `KnownDrift`. Each move is recorded in the sentence beside its figure.
- **New pin, `packages/types/src/__tests__/dashboard-header-global-filters-spec-7759.test.ts`**, with checks on both faces for each key:
  - `Equal` rows showing the declaration and the mirror input each equal the spec member, plus a control row showing the old restatement is not the spec member;
  - `@ts-expect-error` legs for each refused spelling;
  - `safeParse` legs that assert the issue envelope (`code` plus `path`);
  - a check that no `scope` default is authored, and a control document.
- **Existing pins whose premise this PR removes** (fixture triage):
  - `twins-spec-by-reference-9736.test.ts`: `header` is no longer a twin-only omission. The case now asserts it equals the spec member; the `slots` half stays as it was.
  - `p1-spec-alignment.test.ts`: the fixture `{ label: 'Refresh', actionType: 'refresh' }` was legal only under the removed restatement, and the spec and the mirror both refuse it. It is replaced by a spec-legal action that uses a locale-map label, plus an `@ts-expect-error` leg for `refresh`.
  - `report-chart-query-spec-parity.test.ts`: the "pinned divergences" block, which asserted the local schema accepts what the spec refuses, now asserts both schemas give the same verdict on the same literals. The case that pinned the old composition is replaced by one that shows the date refinement still applies when the options are spec-legal.
- **Docs** (AGENTS.md #2; ruling principle 3):
  - `content/docs/plugins/plugin-dashboard.mdx` gives header actions the spec's shape.
  - `content/docs/guide/dashboard-filters.md` says objectui's own validator refuses what the platform refuses, and that `labelField` is required.
  - The `packages/plugin-dashboard/README.md` example comment adds `labelField`. Before this PR it taught an `optionsFrom` the platform refuses at publish.
- **`.changeset/7759-dashboard-header-global-filters-spec.md`**: `@object-ui/types` **minor**, because the validator's `globalFilters` accept set narrows and the `header` interface narrows `actionUrl` / `actionType`. `@object-ui/plugin-dashboard` **patch**, for the renderer fix. The changeset lists the breaking semantics in full.

## Accept-set delta (why Clause-② is yes)

- **Validator, narrowed:**
  - the bare-string option shorthand is refused: `invalid_type` at `globalFilters.N.options.M`;
  - a label-less option is refused: `invalid_union` at `….options.M.label`;
  - an `optionsFrom` with no `labelField` is refused: `invalid_type` at `….optionsFrom.labelField`;
  - an array `optionsFrom.filter` is refused;
  - an unknown key in a filter is now refused by name with `unrecognized_keys` at `globalFilters.N`, where before it was stripped without a message.
- **Validator, widened:** an option `label` may be an inline per-locale map. The spec has always allowed it, and the filter bar already resolves it with `pickLocalized`.
- **Interface, narrowed:** `header.actions[].actionUrl` is required, and `actionType` is limited to the spec's `ActionType`.
- **Interface, widened:** `header.actions[].label` accepts `I18nLabel`.
- **Runtime, deliberately unchanged:** `@object-ui/core`'s `normalizeFilterOptions` still converts a STORED bare-string option on read and logs its deprecation warning, on the objectstack#7917 option-② window ("the spec stays strict; the renderer's lift retires behind a survey"). This is the split objectui#4165 established: the schema refuses the legacy spelling and the read path lifts it. The filter bar also still falls back to `valueField` when `labelField` is absent. Renderers never parse through the mirror; the only runtime callers of `safeValidateSchema` are the CLI's `validate` / `check`, which is the authoring door.

## File surface beyond the claim, declared

The claim listed `complex.ts`, `complex.zod.ts`, this pair's ledger rows, one pin and one changeset. Measurement took this PR further, as the dispatch allows ("若实测表明…按生产者侧修,落点与理由写进报告和 PR 正文"):

- **`DashboardRenderer.tsx` and its test.** Aligning the declaration with the spec is the forced consequence: without the read-site change, a spec-legal document the mirror accepts would still crash the renderer, and principle 1 requires the read site to implement the spec's arm. objectui#9092 / PR #9364 set the same precedent for `plugin-grid`.
- **The three existing `packages/types` pins listed above.** Each one pinned the removed restatement or divergence.
- **Three docs files.** They follow the implementation.

The PM should re-derive serial constraints on `packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DashboardRenderer.tsx`; I did not scan other open PRs (dev contract).

**Consumer direction.** The dependents checked were `core`, `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-designer` and `plugin-list`: the packages the census found importing `DashboardComponentSchema`. `plugin-list`'s hit is a comment. `examples/schema-catalog` and the CLI / app-shell dashboard files cover the validator's accept set.

**Cross-package reverse check.** I pasted a header action with `actionType: 'refresh'` into a probe in `plugin-dashboard`'s test project. It gave `TS2322` against the rebuilt `packages/types/dist`, which shows the consumer reads the new `.d.ts`. The probe was then removed.

## Reverse verification on committed HEAD

Each mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`, and each restore was proven the same way: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The expected direction was registered before each run.

- **A. Mirror: `GlobalFilterSchema` back to the local override** (blob `72d0b6a85b32` to `e52ba4acbdfe`).
  - `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exit 2. The failures: the pin's mirror and local `Equal` rows, `assertionDriftMatchesLedger` and `assertionWiderMatchesLedger` (both naming `complex.zod.ts#DashboardComponentSchema`), and `assertionWiderLedgerRecordsEveryKey` (naming `globalFilters`).
  - vitest: 6 failed / 48 passed.
  - Restored to `72d0b6a85b32`.
- **B. Declaration: hand-written `header` restored** (blob `ace7e75f2ade` to `cfb61c54e999`).
  - `tsc` exit 2, with 10 errors. They cover: the pin's declared `Equal` row and its locale-map literal; two unused `@ts-expect-error` legs; the twins pin; `p1-spec-alignment`; and the three ledger reconciliations, which name the pair and the key `header`.
  - The runtime legs stayed 9 / 9 passed, as registered: the mirror does not move under this mutation.
  - Restored.
- **C. Renderer: `tActionLabel` passes the authored label through unresolved.** vitest: 2 failed / 8 passed, with `Objects are not valid as a React child`. Restored.

## NOT MEASURED

- **Spec Main Shape Gate** (`scripts/spec-main-shape-gate.mjs`). Reason: its workflow builds `@objectstack/spec` from objectstack `main`, injects it, and runs `TURBO_FORCE=true pnpm type-check` across the whole workspace. That is farm-scale, and CI owns it. Mitigation: a source comparison of both touched spec schemas, pin 17.4.0 against `main` `8d1f7ab`, shows no shape difference.
- **`pnpm check:spec-floors`.** A prerequisite failure, not a finding: all 9 findings were `[no-artifact]` for packages outside the built closure. This diff does not move any `@objectstack/spec` range.
- **Repo-wide `pnpm lint` and the full `pnpm test` farm.** Left to CI. The ESLint run above is a narrowed run. Three facts make it a measurement: the population is eslint's own `**/*.{ts,tsx}` config; the file count, 9, comes from the `--format json` output; and `eslint.config.js` declares no `parserOptions` / `projectService`, and no custom `eslint-rules/*` rule reads the filesystem, so type-aware linting is off and this diff cannot move a verdict in an untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- **Runtime lift kept.** `normalizeFilterOptions`, the bare-string lift in `@object-ui/core`, remains. For a validated document it is now a read-path tolerance only, and its retirement stays on objectstack#7917's schedule. It is not touched here.
- **`labelField` fallback kept.** `DashboardFilterBar`'s `from.labelField ? … : …` fallback to `valueField` is unreachable for a validated document and was left in place for stored ones; nobody is assigned to carry it.
- **`name` fallback kept.** The `headerActionDefs` fallback `name: a.actionUrl || label` survives only for a stored action with no `actionUrl`, which the mirror has always refused. It was left in place, matching the click guard.
- **Card body.** The card body's group-A table calls the `globalFilters` difference "inline-locale widening". Measured, it is the local shorthand, and the locale arm ran the other way (see H1). This is recorded so the group-C round does not inherit the wording.
- **Commit trailers.** The first commit carries only the `Claude-Session:` trailer. The later commits carry a model-free `Co-Authored-By: Claude` / `Claude-Session:` pair. History was not rewritten.
- **Scope.** Group C (`FormSchema.layout`) is untouched and remains on the card, which stays open.
